title: It's Time to Wake Up!
summary: Siswa belajar menceritakan rutinitas harian dengan present simple, menanyakan waktu kegiatan, dan memakai adverbs of frequency (always, usually, sometimes).
content:
## Tujuan Belajar

• Menceritakan rutinitas dan kebiasaan sehari-hari dalam bahasa Inggris.
• Bertanya dan menjawab jam berapa kita melakukan sesuatu (What time do you …?).
• Menggunakan present simple, termasuk akhiran -s/-es untuk he/she.
• Menyatakan seberapa sering sesuatu dilakukan dengan always, usually, often, sometimes, never.

## Kosakata Inti

Kosakata unit ini berupa frasa kegiatan sehari-hari, dari pagi (wake up, take a shower, get dressed, have breakfast, pack my bag, go to school) sampai malam (do my homework, have dinner, go to bed). Perhatikan pasangan kata kerjanya: have breakfast, do chores, play video games, practice the flute.

I wake up at 6:00 and take a shower.
After school, I chat with friends and do my homework.
My sister practices the flute before dinner.

## Tata Bahasa: Present Simple & Adverbs of Frequency

Present simple dipakai untuk kebiasaan dan rutinitas. Untuk I/you/we/they pakai kata kerja dasar (I wake up). Untuk he/she/it tambahkan -s atau -es (she wakes up, he goes, she does, he has). Dalam pertanyaan, setelah do/does kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: What time do you wake up? When does he pack his bag?

Keterangan waktu: at + jam (at 7:00), in the morning/afternoon/evening, before/after. Adverbs of frequency menunjukkan seberapa sering: always (100%) → usually → often → sometimes → never (0%). Letakkan sebelum kata kerja utama, tetapi sesudah am/is/are.

I always have breakfast at 6:30.
She usually goes to school by bus.
What time do you go to bed?
When does he pack his bag?
My brother often plays video games after dinner.
I am never late for school.

## Contoh Percakapan

Lia: What time do you wake up on school days?
Bayu: I wake up at 5:30. Then I take a shower and get dressed.
Lia: Wow, that's early! Do you have breakfast at home?
Bayu: Yes, I always have breakfast with my family.
Lia: When does your sister go to school?
Bayu: She goes to school at 6:45. She usually walks with her friend.
Lia: How often do you do chores?
Bayu: I sometimes do chores on weekdays, but I always help on Sundays.

## Ayo Berlatih

What time do you wake up on school days?
Contoh: I wake up at 5:00.

What do you do after school?
Contoh: I have lunch and do my homework.

How often do you play video games?
Contoh: I sometimes play video games on the weekend.

What time does your father go to work?
Contoh: He goes to work at 7:00.

## Tips

• Ingat aturan -s: he/she/it → wakes, goes, does, has. Tetapi setelah does, kembali ke bentuk dasar: Does she wake up early?

• Tulis jadwal harianmu dalam bahasa Inggris (misalnya "6:00 – wake up") dan tempel di kamar. Baca keras-keras setiap pagi!
